The pipeline currently skips the validation step because the reference table is empty. The reporting dashboard shows a null value for the promotion week score in every regional view. The nightly job logs confirm that the KPI calculation module is not invoked. No threshold or formula exists in the codebase for this specific metric. The system proceeds to generate the standard availability and waste reports without attempting to compute the promotion week figure. The data warehouse contains no historical values for this KPI, as it has never been populated. The current state is simply that the metric is absent from the operational workflow.
